resources.string: Allows TapPilot Agent to read on-screen UI elements, receive notification triggers, capture screen context for AI reasoning, and perform automated tap, scroll, and text-entry gestures on your behalf. A floating control pill with an instant Stop button remains visible during automation.
Native Kotlin Accessibility + Multi-Provider AI Agent
TapPilot uses Android AccessibilityService to read screen nodes, dispatch real tap gestures, and render a safe floating Stop overlay without extra display-over-apps permissions.
Runs continuously in background cycles, wakes immediately on new notifications, retains AI working memory, and blocks only payment/checkout actions.
Describe what the agent should do
e.g. Search Gillette Guard around 180tk, post in group, reply on Messenger
Enter a goal above and launch the agent. Every screen observation, notification trigger, AI decision, and tap coordinate will stream here.
Uses built-in Firebase AI Logic (gemini-3.8-flash) with App Check (requires google-services.json in APK).
API Keys (1 per line or comma-separated, 1–30+)
Paste 1 to 30+ keys here. If one hits rate limit or fails, the next key resumes from the exact failed step.
Paste at least 1 API key above before launching with this provider.
If one provider hits limits, seamlessly resume the same step on Google AI Studio, Groq Cloud, or OpenRouter.
Rotates 1 call per step across Groq, Gemini & OpenRouter keys with 65s rate-limit auto-cooldown.
Stays on your selected primary provider and key until an error occurs, then fails over.
Sends fast text-only UI tree on standard screens (~0.4s) and reserves screenshots for games, Step 1, or error recovery.
For Carrom & games: starts 2nd key/provider in parallel if 1st key exceeds 450ms; first valid shot wins instantly.
Remembers verified app launches, menus & taps locally and replays them with 0 API calls.
Computes Ghost-Ball cut angles, blocked-path checks, foul guards, and rolling-coin waits locally with 0 API calls.
Draws subtle X/Y pixel reference lines on game screenshots so AI reads exact coordinates.
Draws numbered [1], [2], [3] bounding boxes on buttons & fields in AI screenshots (AppAgent / DroidRun style) to eliminate mis-taps.
Captures screen bitmap on Android 11+ alongside UI node tree for higher accuracy.
Researches game rules, drag/tap controls, winning shots, and fouls first before touching the screen.
Allows games, posting, commenting, and messaging freely while pausing only for payments, checkout, or PIN/OTP.
Go to Home Screen on Launch
Automatically minimizes TapPilot so the agent starts directly from your launcher.
Prevents display sleep while TapPilot dashboard stays open for desk monitoring.
Unfamiliar games or tasks are automatically researched first, then refined from every shot & foul outcome.
Verified app launches, lobby buttons, and UI navigation steps are saved automatically here and replayed next time with 0 AI calls.
Keeps all-day AI screen & notification monitoring active with an instant Stop button.
Waits silently after messaging someone on Facebook, Messenger, or WhatsApp until they reply back—never spams follow-up messages.
Skips unknown chats and only replies to people saved in your Relationship Contacts list below.
Waits silently with 0 API calls until a real message notification appears, opens only that sender ID, checks Relationship Contacts first, and replies politely if unsaved.
Save contacts by Name + App (WhatsApp / WA Business / Facebook) + Relationship (বন্ধু, GF, ভাই, বোন, পরিবার, Business) so the agent chats in the right tone automatically.
e.g. Talk in casual Banglish, call him mama, avoid late night texts
Streaming live 50–100ms frames with zero screenshot cooldown for precision Carrom shots.
Keeps low-latency MediaProjection screen capture active for instant Carrom frame analysis.
Eliminates Android’s 1-second Accessibility screenshot delay using MediaProjection for 50–100ms closed-loop frames.
Simulates 20–45 angle & power rollouts before shooting to catch kiss collisions, rail bounces, and striker scratches.
Uses Sobel gradient radial Hough votes to lock disc centers within 0.2px and separate touching break clusters.
Saves every pre/post-slide board scan into turn memory, slides up to 6 times within 7s, and fuses all data to fire a zero-foul Sure Shot.
Freestyle: White, Black & Red (Queen) are all legal targets — ONLY striker pocket scratch is a foul.
Disc Pool: Only your selected coin color & Red (Queen) are targeted; pocketing only opponent coins or scratching is a foul.
Stays running in background. Whenever any app shows a message notification, opens that sender, checks Relationship Contacts first, or talks simply & politely if unsaved.
Show draggable Pause/Stop box over apps. Keep OFF (default) to show status and controls only in the notification panel without blocking the screen.
Play a few Carrom matches yourself while TapPilot watches silently (0 touches), saves winning cut angles, striker positions, power & friction feel, and applies them when playing autonomously.
